A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IMM study. All pages, including appendices, equations, figures and tables, support comparison, and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original self-improvement, distillation, OOD evaluation and layer-analysis results.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds intervention comparisons, sensitivity analyses, model evaluations and diagnostic results.

M1.justification: v2 introduces importance-based iterative model merging, IIMM, whose update weights each layer's parameter change by normalized importance (Equation 7). This adds an evaluated alternative procedure; the primary IMM algorithm, including SFT, DARE and uniform merging, remains unchanged.

E1.justification: v2 adds MBPP code-generation data for the layer-importance analysis in Appendix B.2/Figure 11, extending the analysis beyond mathematical reasoning. The mathematical and STEM evaluation datasets, including v1's supplementary OOD datasets, are retained.

E2.justification: v2 substantially broadens the evaluated alternatives with gradient decay, gradient clipping and weight masking in Table 5, plus IIMM in Table 6. The existing Vanilla/STaR, Data Mixture and Data Accumulation comparisons remain.

E3.justification: Added experiments introduce a seven-value merging-weight sweep (Table 3), specified SFT-intervention settings (Table 5), and first-iteration Llama3-8B evaluation (Table 9). Existing main training settings and the pass@k definition remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds substantial sensitivity and diagnostic evidence: merging-weight sensitivity, importance-weighted merging tests, MAWPS failure-case analyses, MBPP layer importance, and weight changes across iterations. The limited-real-data and base-model layer analyses already present in v1 are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, standard deviations or significance tests for its experiments. The added results continue point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: v2 adds numerous intervention, sensitivity, failure-case and model results. For example, new Table 9 reports Llama3-8B GSM8K scores of 55.1 for Base, 53.4 for SFT and 61.2 for IMM. Original figure results, distillation Table 2, and v1 Table 3 retained as v2 Table 4 are unchanged.

T1.justification: v2 corrects Equation 5 to subtract the previous merged model, matching the procedure already described in v1. Appendix B.10/Table 10 adds operation-wise complexity reasoning, giving O(T(F(n)+n)) and its training-dominated approximation. No new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the central claims: self-improvement can sacrifice OOD reasoning, layer importance and updates are misaligned, and IMM mitigates collapse while preserving generalization. Condensed wording does not materially change these claims.

C2.justification: v2 adds hypotheses about SFT's layer-update bias, self-generated data inhibiting critical-layer updates, IIMM instability, MAWPS failures and model-capacity effects. It also qualifies model-size trends and clarifies the empirical status of layer terminology. Some new interpretations overstate their evidence, notably Appendix B.6's description of Table 8.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-access hyperlink and discloses three generated candidates per GSM8K question and six per MATH question. These counts are newly documented; a change to prior sampling practice is not established. Existing hardware, optimization and training-budget details are retained.

R1.justification: Appendices C.2 and C.5-C.9 substantially expand positioning against ordinary SFT overfitting, layer-selection research and data-diversity approaches, adding works such as Merchant et al., Mosbach et al., Li et al. and Dohmatob et al. The earlier random-smoothing and regularization comparison and several associated citations are removed.

P1.justification: The appendices are substantially reorganized: former Appendices A-F become grouped training, experiment and discussion subsections. The reasoning-related-work passage moves from Section 2 to Appendix C.9. Contribution and conclusion wording is revised, and acknowledgement and risk sections are added.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 3 and 5-10 and Figures 11-12. The original four-panel Figure 8 is split between Figure 8 for GSM8K and Figure 13 for MATH. All original plots remain, while the added displays and relocations substantially expand and reorganize the visual presentation.

improvement.justification: The new intervention comparisons, merging ablations and diagnostic results address gaps in v1's empirical support, while candidate counts and code-access information improve reproducibility. The gain is limited by inaccurate new interpretations: Appendix B.6 claims superiority over both comparison models on five OOD datasets, but Table 8 supports this only for SAT_Math and MMLU_stem. The added checkable evidence nevertheless provides a limited net improvement.
